{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfziGz9y6L1aR4JZAByKK","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01WtrCmBYVBW9TE9W79Ngn35","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261012-111947/cahn-hilliard_claude-haiku-5.5-cc-medium_mpi_r4/cahn-hilliard/cahn_hilliard.cpp","content":"#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <climits>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <utility>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Halo message tags\nconstexpr int TAG_UP = 0;    // plane sent to the rank above\nconstexpr int TAG_DOWN = 1;  // plane sent to the rank below\n\n// 3D index calculation\ninline constexpr size_t idx3(const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) noexcept {\n    return z * (nx * ny) + y * nx + x;\n}\n\n// Z-slab owned by one rank. Local fields hold nzLocal + 2 planes: planes 1..nzLocal\n// are owned (global planes z0..z0+nzLocal-1), planes 0 and nzLocal+1 are ghosts.\nstruct Slab {\n    size_t z0 = 0;\n    size_t nzLocal = 0;\n    int down = MPI_PROC_NULL;  // rank owning the plane below, MPI_PROC_NULL at the domain edge\n    int up = MPI_PROC_NULL;    // rank owning the plane above, MPI_PROC_NULL at the domain edge\n};\n\n// Block distribution of nz planes over size ranks (the first nz % size ranks get one extra plane)\nSlab makeSlab(const size_t nz, const int rank, const int size) {\n    const size_t P = static_cast<size_t>(size);\n    const size_t r = static_cast<size_t>(rank);\n    const size_t base = nz / P;\n    const size_t rem = nz % P;\n    auto count = [&](const size_t q) { return base + (q < rem ? 1 : 0); };\n\n    Slab s;\n    s.nzLocal = count(r);\n    s.z0 = r * base + std::min(r, rem);\n    if (s.nzLocal > 0) {\n        if (r > 0) s.down = rank - 1;\n        if (r + 1 < P && count(r + 1) > 0) s.up = rank + 1;\n    }\n    return s;\n}\n\n// Starts the ghost-plane exchange of field f. Ghosts at the domain edges are copies of the\n// boundary plane, which reproduces the clamped boundary conditions of the serial code.\nvoid startHalo(std::vector<double>& f, const Slab& s, const size_t nxy, MPI_Datatype plane,\n               MPI_Comm comm, MPI_Request (&req)[4]) {\n    for (auto& r : req) r = MPI_REQUEST_NULL;\n    if (s.nzLocal == 0) return;\n\n    double* ghostLow = f.data();\n    double* ownLow = f.data() + nxy;\n    double* ownHigh = f.data() + s.nzLocal * nxy;\n    double* ghostHigh = f.data() + (s.nzLocal + 1) * nxy;\n\n    if (s.down == MPI_PROC_NULL) std::copy_n(ownLow, nxy, ghostLow);\n    if (s.up == MPI_PROC_NULL) std::copy_n(ownHigh, nxy, ghostHigh);\n\n    MPI_Irecv(ghostLow, 1, plane, s.down, TAG_UP, comm, &req[0]);\n    MPI_Irecv(ghostHigh, 1, plane, s.up, TAG_DOWN, comm, &req[1]);\n    MPI_Isend(ownLow, 1, plane, s.down, TAG_DOWN, comm, &req[2]);\n    MPI_Isend(ownHigh, 1, plane, s.up, TAG_UP, comm, &req[3]);\n}\n\n// Compute Laplacian with clamped boundary conditions. Local plane k is the z-index;\n// z-neighbours come from the ghost planes.\ndouble computeLaplacian(const std::vector<double>& c, const size_t nx, const size_t ny,\n                        const double dx, const double dy, const double dz, const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t k) {\n    const size_t xp = (x < nx - 1) ? x + 1 : x;\n    const size_t yp = (y < ny - 1) ? y + 1 : y;\n    const size_t xn = (x > 0) ? x - 1 : 0;\n    const size_t yn = (y > 0) ? y - 1 : 0;\n\n    const size_t center = idx3(x, y, k, nx, ny);\n    const double cxx = (c[idx3(xp, y, k, nx, ny)] + c[idx3(xn, y, k, nx, ny)] -\n                  2.0 * c[center]) / (dx * dx);\n    const double cyy = (c[idx3(x, yp, k, nx, ny)] + c[idx3(x, yn, k, nx, ny)] -\n                  2.0 * c[center]) / (dy * dy);\n    const double czz = (c[center + nx * ny] + c[center - nx * ny] -\n                  2.0 * c[center]) / (dz * dz);\n\n    return cxx + cyy + czz;\n}\n\n// Compute chemical potential on local planes [kBegin, kEnd)\nvoid computeChemicalPotential(const std::vector<double>& c, std::vector<double>& mu,\n                              const size_t nx, const size_t ny,\n                              const double dx, const double dy, const double dz,\n                              const double gamma, const double e_AA, const double e_BB, const double e_AB,\n                              const size_t kBegin, const size_t kEnd) {\n    for (size_t k = kBegin; k < kEnd; ++k) {\n        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {\n                const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, k, nx, ny);\n                const double cv = c[idx];\n\n                mu[idx] = 4.5 * ((cv + 1.0) * e_AA + (cv - 1.0) * e_BB - 2.0 * cv * e_AB)\n                         + 3.0 * cv + cv * cv * cv\n                         - gamma * computeLaplacian(c, nx, ny, dx, dy, dz, x, y, k);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Cahn-Hilliard update step on local planes [kBegin, kEnd)\nvoid cahnHilliardUpdate(std::vector<double>& cnew, const std::vector<double>& cold,\n                        const std::vector<double>& mu,\n                        const size_t nx, const size_t ny,\n                        const double D, const double dt, const double dx, const double dy, const double dz,\n                        const size_t kBegin, const size_t kEnd) {\n {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cfzik7wH87hFBPCqYXU6D","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The solver now runs under MPI, and its output matches the original serial code exactly in every case I tested.\n\n**What changed** (only `cahn-hilliard/cahn_hilliard.cpp` and `cahn-hilliard/CMakeLists.txt`):\n\n- **Decomposition:** the grid is split into contiguous z-slabs, one per rank, with an even block distribution. Each rank stores its planes plus two ghost planes.\n- **Halo exchange:** each time step has two exchanges, one for `c` before the chemical potential and one for `mu` before the update. Interior planes are computed while the messages are in flight, and only the two edge planes wait for the ghosts.\n- **Boundaries:** at the global z-edges the ghost is a copy of the edge plane. That reproduces the original clamped boundary condition exactly.\n- **Output:** `-r` and `-v` gather the full field to rank 0, which prints the same `print_results` block and validation as before. The gather is needed because the Kahan sum and FNV hash are order-dependent over the whole field. Rank 0 alone prints; all ranks return the same exit code.\n- **Timing:** barriers around the time loop and `MPI_Wtime`, so the reported time is the slowest rank's. The MCUPS figure now divides by unrounded seconds, so it can differ very slightly from the old millisecond-truncated value.\n- **CMake:** `find_package(MPI REQUIRED)` and link `MPI::MPI_CXX`. There is no option to turn MPI off, and the target name is unchanged.\n\n**Verification:**\n- Built with no warnings under `-Wall -Wextra`.\n- Compared the `-r -v` output against the original serial build for 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8 ranks, on cubic and non-cubic grids, with `nz` smaller than the rank count, and with `-i 0`. All matched exactly, including the hash.\n- Repeated multi-rank runs showed no hangs. The earlier apparent stall was the comparison script exceeding my 120 s tool timeout, not a deadlock.\n- Scaling on a 192³ grid, 10 steps: 133 → 314 → 547 → 985 MCUPS at 1, 2, 4 and 8 ranks.\n\n**Choices you may want to revisit:**\n- Ranks beyond `nz` sit idle. I chose that over rejecting the run.\n- The program errors out if `nx*ny` or `nz` exceeds `INT_MAX`, because MPI counts are `int`.\n- The per-cell arithmetic is unchanged on purpose, so results stay bit-identical. I did not restructure the kernel for vectorization.\n\nThe project is not a git repository, so nothing was committed. Build and test artifacts went to `/tmp`, not the project."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":877,"cache_read_input_tokens":61583,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":877},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"ea59cb20-e282-469f-b479-3b943e4b8e41","uuid":"f8a375e3-fb52-474a-9916-dce3af35018d","timestamp":"2026-10-13T18:36:47.985Z","request_id":"req_011Cfzik7dvJjGcMGjwsB35y"}
